arguments.description: Export Account Balances By Group With Export Settings. Part of the Account Balances V2 APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

showHideOpeningClosingBalance.description: When true, applies the show hide opening closing balance filter or flag.

balanceTypeAsSign.description: When true, applies the balance type as sign filter or flag.
